For a renter, I’d look at the **BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100 W solar panel kit**. The panel can sit on your balcony during the day and recharge the power station, which you can bring inside. It’s a compact, no-wiring setup with a 288 Wh LiFePO₄ battery—suited to phones, a laptop, router, or fan, but **not** a fridge or heater. [Kit details and buy link](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-for-an-apartment-balcony)

Before setting it up, check your lease and building rules, and make sure the panel is securely placed. This kind of kit powers devices from the station; it **doesn’t feed electricity into your apartment’s wiring**. ([Balcony kit guide](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-for-an-apartment-balcony))
